ἐξομηρ-εύω ,
A.bind by taking hostages, [τοὺς δούλους] ταῖς τεκνοποΐαις ἐ. bind slaves to one's service by the pledges of wives and children, Arist. Oec. 1344b17 , cf. Phld. Oec. p.33J. :— Med. , “νήπιοι ψυχῆς φίλτρα -εύσασθαι δυνάμενα στρατηγὸν πρὸς πατρίδα”
Onos. 1.12
; also, produce by hostages,
“φιλίαν”
Str. 6.4.2
; bind to oneself,
D.S. 27.7 ; win over, SIG 656.21 (Abdera, ii B. C., found at Teos).
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
